summary.intent: Implement a minimal, production-minded Pydantic incident model and pytest coverage while preserving the existing FastAPI application and avoiding unrelated changes, unnecessary dependencies, commits, or pushes.
summary.outcome: Added the Incident model with required fields, severity/status enums, and UTC timestamp handling; all 37 tests passed. FastAPI import, route, and handler checks passed, although HTTP TestClient smoke testing stalled.

repo: The project contains a minimal FastAPI application, with Pydantic and pytest already installed.
The model addition required no changes to the existing application.

code.finding: Incident defines the required fields and enums; created_at defaults to current UTC, normalizes supplied timezone-aware timestamps to UTC, and rejects naive timestamps.
Model coverage includes valid incidents, invalid severity/status values, and timestamp behavior; 37 tests passed.

workflow: Inspected the project and available dependencies before implementing changes.
Kept changes limited to the model and its tests, without installing dependencies, committing, or pushing.
Supplemented model tests with application import, route, and handler checks.

friction: HTTP TestClient smoke testing stalled, leaving HTTP-level application verification incomplete.
